title: Target Account discovery PowerSync provider and isolated selection exercise

surfaces.currentBehavior: Executable local AccountQuerying adapter over exact Principal bootstrap rows and independently reactive query-specific completeness plus freshness.
surfaces.notes: Local-only implementation; hosted bootstrap authorization and Sync proof remain excluded.

securityRequirements: Only active same-Principal membership relationships may expose Account rows
syncRequirements: Query completeness and freshness are independent, typed and reactive
Ready/stale transitions emit without row changes
Restart cannot infer fresh authority from historical sync metadata
Missing Account relationships cannot become authoritative empty

migration.rule: Read only target local rows; no Firebase adapter or source cache.
reconciliation: Removal disappears when synchronized without making cached state fresh authority

acceptance: Exact local scope/readiness/failure/restart/cancellation and selection-intent behavior passes

surfaces.currentBehavior: Executable encrypted environment/Principal bootstrap runtime that exposes AccountQuerying without activating an Account workspace.
surfaces.notes: The runtime validates a contained opaque filesystem namespace before any Keychain mutation and preserves local data on close; no Auth, stream connector, workspace switch or deletion behavior exists.

syncRequirements: Runtime supplies only Account discovery until later activation coordination

reconciliation: Later workspace activation owns current authorization and session transition

acceptance: Runtime rejects rebinding and preserves encrypted cached discovery state

surfaces.currentBehavior: Executable ten-test local suite for Account discovery, readiness/freshness, isolation, bounded failures, restart, cancellation, namespace containment and explicit selection.
surfaces.notes: Synthetic local tests prove adapter scoping only and must not be described as server RLS or hosted Sync authorization proof.

securityRequirements: Rejected rebinding must prove zero database access
Provider failures expose only bounded diagnostics
syncRequirements: False-empty, reactive completeness/freshness, row-independent ready/stale transitions, restart initialization, before/after-cache failure and cancellation coverage are mandatory

migration.rule: Use only synthetic identities and disposable encrypted databases.
reconciliation: No source migration, server RLS or hosted claim

acceptance: All planned local obligations pass before implementation status

surfaces.currentBehavior: Executable isolated staging rendering and exact Account-selection intent creation over the backend-neutral query port.
surfaces.notes: The staging component is build-only and existing staging-root runtime wiring is explicitly excluded. Cached rows remain visible after a bounded provider failure; no automatic selection, workspace activation, hosted connection or production behavior.

securityRequirements: Render visibility-safe summaries and bounded diagnostics only
syncRequirements: Render waiting/partial/stale/ready states without false empty

reconciliation: Selection remains local intent and activates nothing

acceptance: An explicit current-row action creates the exact selection intent without defaulting
